notes.heading: Codification
notes.text: Sections 46–1 to 46–3, relating to Territory of Alaska, were omitted in view of admission of Alaska into the Union. Section 46–1, act July 28, 1956, ch. 772, title I, § 101, 70 Stat. 709, authorized territorial legislature to enact laws on subject of mental health. Section 46–2, act July 28, 1956, ch. 772, title I, § 102, 70 Stat. 709, related to jurisdiction, functions and duties of commissioners and courts in carrying out section 46–1 of this title. Section 46–3, act July 28, 1956, ch. 772, title II, § 202, 70 Stat. 711, prescribed a land-grant program for purpose of section 46–1 of this title.
